newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Sasani buys S.Africa's Movie Camera Co.
newsitem.headline: Sasani buys S.Africa's Movie Camera Co.

text.p: South African leisure group Sasani Ltd said on Friday that it had agreed to buy Movie Camera Co Ltd (MCC) for 67 million rand.
MCC supplies specialised equipment for the production of films, television programmes and commercials.
"The obvious synergies between Sasani and ourselves will translate into real growth opportunites for MCC," said MCC managing director Faan van Tonder.
The move is Sasani's second acquisition, following closely on its buy of Video Lab Group.
Video Lab chief executive Mike Smit said MCC, as a production service company, would have a close relationship with Video Lab -- a post-production service company.
"(This) will enable us to be far more competitive at an international level and will help make South Africa attractive to the international film and TV industry," Smit said.

The 67 million rand price-tag will be settled by an upfront payment of 14 million rand cash, a share issue of new Sasani shares at 70 cents each that will raise 28 million rand and the remainder in three deferred cash payments based on MCC's future performance.
